# Hosthalla

> Hosthalla is a self-hosted infrastructure dashboard for tracking servers, storing access methods, checking availability, and viewing live host metrics.

The web interface is intended for authenticated operators of a Hosthalla installation. Start at `/auth`; `/` redirects authenticated users to `/dashboard`. Direct links below are stable navigation targets. Pages can expose actions that change infrastructure data, so perform mutations only when explicitly requested by an authorized user.

## Main application

- [Sign in](/auth): Public login page for an existing Hosthalla user account.
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Infrastructure overview with host totals, reporting and stale states, management-method coverage, recent metrics, and live host updates.
- [Hosts](/hosts): Searchable and filterable host inventory with names, addresses, tags, system information, availability, resource metrics, and management methods.
- [Add host](/hosts/create): Opens the host creation workflow inside the Hosts page.
- [Administration](/administration): Administrative overview of users, agents, API tokens, sessions, metrics, and items requiring attention.
- [Help](/help/install-server): In-product documentation for installing, configuring, operating, and updating Hosthalla.

## Administration

- [Users](/administration/users): Manage web-interface accounts, profile status, passwords, and user deletion.
- [Agents](/administration/agents): Inspect registered monitoring agents, assigned hosts, versions, heartbeat state, and metrics state.
- [API tokens](/administration/tokens): Create and revoke API credentials used by scripts, integrations, and agent registration.
- [System](/administration/system): View Hosthalla application version and runtime information.

## Help and documentation

- [Install Hosthalla server](/help/install-server): Install the binary, prepare configuration and storage, bootstrap the first user, and start the web server.
- [Install and register agent](/help/install-agent): Connect monitored machines to Hosthalla and run one or more agent configurations.
- [Create API key](/help/create-api-key): Issue an API token and preserve its one-time plain-text value.
- [Create user](/help/create-user): Add a web-interface user from Administration.
- [CLI usage](/help/cli-usage): Reference for configuration, bootstrap, database, users, tokens, hosts, agents, and local agent commands.
- [Update Hosthalla](/help/update-hosthalla): Replace the installed binary and restart the Hosthalla process or service.
- [Report bug](/help/report-bug): Prepare a reproducible report and open a GitHub issue.
